guardrails.readonly.description: Read-only guardrails injected into review prompts

guardrails.writable.description: Write-capable guardrails injected into fix/run prompts

guardrails.tests.description: Guardrails for test-generation jobs — blocks all production source modifications

guardrails.docs.description: Guardrails for documentation-generation jobs — only docs/ writes allowed

review.description: Default code review task prompt — produces a JSON findings object

fix-pr.description: Fixes review comments on a pull request by making targeted code changes

fix-comment.description: Applies a fix for a specific finding raised in a pull request review thread

reply.description: Responds to a developer comment on a pull request review thread

generate-tests.description: Generates or improves unit tests for a project (Java, C#, TypeScript, PHP)

generate-docs.description: Generates comprehensive Markdown documentation for a software project

metrics-fix.description: Refactors methods to reduce cyclomatic complexity without changing behaviour (Java, C#, TypeScript, PHP)

planner.description: Creates a markdown plan document from a specification

pr-summary.description: Produces a structured JSON summary of a pull request diff

intent-classifier.description: Classifies a developer reply to a review comment as FIX or DISCUSS

learning-extractor.description: Extracts a generalizable team preference or convention from a review thread

finding-resolver.batch.description: Checks a batch of open review findings against the current code to determine which are resolved

finding-resolver.single.description: Checks whether a single open review finding has been addressed in the current code

self-review.description: Self-review prompt: agent reviews its own diff against the original task before linter/build validation

build-retry.description: Prompt for fixing build or test failures introduced by the agent's own changes

chat-system.description: System prompt for the freeform chat endpoint — includes Markdown, Mermaid, and Chart.js formatting instructions

review-epic.description: AI readiness and complexity review for a Jira Epic

review-feature.description: AI readiness and complexity review for a Jira Feature

review-userstory.description: AI readiness and complexity review for a Jira User Story

improve-epic.description: AI rewrite of a Jira Epic to sharpen goal, scope, and acceptance conditions

improve-feature.description: AI rewrite of a Jira Feature to be user-focused, testable, and sprint-ready

improve-userstory.description: AI rewrite of a Jira User Story following Given/When/Then best practices
